meta: Asked AI to plan Mom's birthday in one sentence, and every part came out thin? Bit suggests prompt chaining: split it into steps, with the result of each step feeding into the next.

muc.title: One sentence, a huge job
muc.text: Mark asks AI in one sentence: plan Mom's birthday, including guests, menu, invitations and budget. The result has every part, but every part is thin.

muc.title: Chain small steps together
muc.text: Bit suggests prompt chaining. Split it into steps, where the result of one step becomes the input for the next.

muc.title: One step at a time
muc.text: Step one: settle on a $150 budget and twenty guests. Step two: a menu for twenty people within that $150. Step three: invitations that mention the right dishes.

muc.title: Each step gets full focus
muc.text: In each step, AI handles just one thing, so it does it more carefully. And you check and fix after each step, before a mistake spreads to the next.

muc.title: Same conversation
muc.text: Do the steps in the same conversation, so AI can still see what you've decided, as in video 9 about context.

muc.title: Tasks with many parts
muc.text: Use it for tasks with many parts: reports, travel itineraries, presentations. It's also how AI agents work on their own, as in video 16.

muc.title: Split first, then do
muc.text: Pick one big task this week, ask AI to break it into four steps first, then work through each step with it.
